note: v3 adopts the acts kernel for the five structural events: outline_item_added/removed/moved/reordered/hidden are emitted as schema-validated acts whose domain fields are enveloped under `payload` ({type, version, payload}) instead of flat observation fields. No stored object state changes shape - items, edges, focus, and undo state are untouched - so this migration performs no data rewrites (steps is empty; the manifest update itself delivers the new verbs, the $outline_meta projection class, and the @local:acts dependency). Consumers (client reducers, formatters) must accept both shapes while pre-v3 definitions remain deployed; the movement-hook echo path (enterfunc capture, exitfunc detach under a foreign authority) still emits legacy flat observations until cross-space act routing exists.
